info.name: ZoolGo API v1
info.description: Generated from docs/openapi.yaml (npm run docs:postman). Start with "0 · Login": request a code, then verify — dev servers return devOtp, so no SMS is needed. Rules: docs/API_CONVENTIONS.md.

request.description: Move one passenger to another free seat of the same trip (same ticket number, free; women-only respected)
Other trips of the same carrier and cities on ?date= with enough seats and the price difference
Price a trip change from seat holds on the new trip: new total, fee, payMinor or refundMinor (cash: collectOnBoardMinor)
Apply the trip change (Idempotency-Key). Higher price: new booking PENDING_PAYMENT + payment, old stays valid until paid; lower: refund; old booking becomes CHANGED
Seat change on the same trip (broker.book)
Candidate trips for a trip change on ?date=
Price a trip change from held seats (tripId, seatIds): wallet payMinor/refundMinor and new commission
Apply the trip change: wallet debit/credit of the difference + fee, commission clawed back and re-accrued, old booking CHANGED

Confirm and pay from the wallet (Idempotency via idempotencyKey). D-RT-01: optional returnTrip {tripId, seatIds} books both legs atomically (two debits, one group; response returnBooking). Passengers may carry gender; women-only seats need FEMALE (422 WOMEN_ONLY_SEAT)
